content:
Guy looking for advice about finding alternatives to Natural Tan MCoBeauty Instant Concealer?
I bought this [MCoBeauty Instant Concealer](https://imgur.com/vLvV2ZQ) in [Natural Tan](https://imgur.com/qlHxrMR) colour a couple of years ago on the advice of some female friends for hiding pimple/red spots for formal events. 

I previously got it from [chemist warehouse](https://www.chemistwarehouse.com.au/buy/118789/mcobeauty-instant-concealer-camouflage-contour-natural-tan). Unfortunately my current one is running low and I have been checking in multiple stores for a few months with no luck.

They seem to restock all the other colours like the ivory and medium but I have never seen this one restocked since my first purchase of it. 

I've tried checking for other brands alternative but they describe their colours differently and not all of them have samples I can directly compare in the store.

Is there another brand's instant concealer with this same colour shade that is more available or any concealer alternatives you guys might be able to recommend?
